query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

per_column.name: service_quality
per_column.rationale: A core theme for satisfaction/complaint analysis with a well-distributed categorical scale. Row samples align well: worst-service review is 'poor', Oliveo/Michelle 'excellent', pizza 'good'.

per_column.name: staff_attitude
per_column.rationale: Distinct axis from service_quality (attitude vs efficiency), useful for complaint themes. Values mostly grounded; 'indifferent' for the forgotten-twice review is a defensible reading, though 'rude/negligent' could be argued. Sound overall.

per_column.name: food_taste_rating
per_column.rationale: Central satisfaction theme with good distribution and correct not_present handling for non-food reviews (real estate, nightclub). Pizza rated 'good' matches 'very good pizta'; well grounded.

per_column.name: standout_item_mention
per_column.rationale: A bare boolean flag with limited analytical leverage; it partially overlaps with food_taste and adds a thin new axis. Values are grounded (specific dishes mentioned = True). Least useful of the set but not redundant enough to score near zero.

per_column.name: value_perception
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a genuine distinct complaint theme. Mostly grounded, but 'overpriced' for the pizza review is a borderline inference (reviewer muses about staying under $20, not an explicit complaint of overpricing), and 'great_value' for Oliveo leans on the free-pita mention. Reasonable but slightly overconfident.

per_column.name: ambiance_atmosphere
per_column.rationale: Ambiance is a standard, distinct review theme useful for grouping. Not_present used appropriately; 'neutral' for the pizza review (mentions lunch crowd) is a reasonable reading. Well grounded.

judge.rationale: The added columns decompose Yelp reviews into distinct, analytically meaningful themes (service, staff, food, value, ambiance) that directly serve the satisfaction/complaint query, each providing a separate grouping axis. Values are largely sound readings of the source text with appropriate not_present handling for silent rows. Minor overconfidence appears in value_perception (inferring 'overpriced'/'great_value' from tentative cues). standout_item_mention is the weakest link as a thin boolean flag, but it is not redundant. No serious hallucinations observed.
